Name: Zedad
ModernLocation: Unknown; candidates include Sadad and Khirbet Serada
Description: Zedad was a town on the northern boundary of the land, named in the boundary list of Numbers 34 and again in Ezekiel's vision of the restored allotment.
BiblicalSignificance: Zedad is a boundary name: a northern marker of the promised land in both Moses' list and Ezekiel's vision.
